none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained operator root-finding in ℝᵈ under a Minty condition. The continuous operator F has a zero z with ‖x₀−z‖ ≤ R and ⟨F(x),x−z⟩ ≥ 0 for every x.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: One call at any x ∈ ℝᵈ returns the exact vector F(x) for every history and seed. The algorithm knows d, L₀, L₁, R, ε, and x₀. The operator and the witnessing zero are hidden. Adaptive randomized algorithms are allowed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedLipschitzMinty.lean, Params and spec.{Public,publicInput,Query,Reply,admissible}. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y and every upper bound M on ‖F‖ along [x,y], the operator satisfies ‖F(x)−F(y)‖ ≤ (L₀+L₁M)‖x−y‖, with L₀ > 0 and L₁ ≥ 0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The space is Euclidean ℝᵈ. With T = R(L₀/ε+L₁), the dimension satisfies d ≥ 8192(1+⌊(T/1024)²⌋)³.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The parameter regime requires R ≥ 0, ε > 0, T ≥ 1024, and 32 log(1+L₁ε/L₀) ≤ L₁R.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The residual must be integrable and satisfy E[‖F(X)‖] ≤ ε under the execution law.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The algorithm returns a single point X ∈ ℝᵈ. Accuracy is measured by the Euclidean operator residual ‖F(X)‖ to the first power. X may be any output point, including one the algorithm did not query.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines a Minty zero with norm-dependent segment smoothness and imposes an explicit high-dimensional regime tied to the accuracy, smoothness parameters, and initial radius.
